_meta.note: TR thresholds per species; medal is the highest threshold reached (TR >= diamond -> Diamond, else >= gold -> Gold, else >= silver -> Silver). TR is only comparable within a species: a 251.0 means nothing for a Roe Deer.
_meta.units: trophy rating, same scale as the save file Score field
_meta.bronze: NO SOURCE PUBLISHES THE BRONZE CUT-OFF. All three datasets (APS binary struct, TacMaps, 2022 community chart) store only silver/gold/diamond. bronze is therefore null in every entry. Two independent statements on the Fandom wiki imply any animal carrying a trophy organ is at least Bronze and 'None' is reserved for trophy-less animals (e.g. female deer), so a practical fallback is bronze := 0 (or bronze := silver, if you want a real gradient). The APS binary's struct has only an f32[3] at +0x1C followed by f32[2] that are always 0.0, so any bronze rule is computed in code -- worth finding in its disassembly.
_meta.great_one: Not recorded. Great Ones (difficulty 10 'Fabled') exist for Whitetail Deer, Red Deer, Black Bear, Moose, Fallow Deer, Tahr, Red Fox, Ring-necked Pheasant, Mule Deer, Gray Wolf, Wild Boar, Roe Deer, Jaguar and Taruca (count grows with each DLC). No source publishes a per-species Great One TR threshold; observed specimens sit well above the Diamond cut-off (e.g. Red Deer 272.60, Fallow Deer 273.36). Deliberately omitted rather than guessed.
_meta.scale_warning: TR is NOT a global scale -- it is an arbitrary per-species score, and the same number means different things for different animals. Across this file the Diamond threshold sits at roughly 1x the species' max body weight in kg for 32 species, ~10x for 4, ~100x for 7 and ~1000x for 13 (ducks, teal, quail and ptarmigan effectively score their weight in grams: Gadwall 1050 vs 1.06 kg). Never rank animals, and never colour-code, by comparing TR values across species -- always compare a Score against its own species' thresholds.
_meta.method: Numbers come from the Animal Population Scanner binary (species_stats.json triple_0x1C, minted from the tool the user is replacing) and are marked VERIFIED when the independently maintained TacMaps dataset agrees within 1% on all three thresholds.

confidence_legend.VERIFIED: two independent sources agree on silver/gold/diamond
confidence_legend.LIKELY: one source, or sources disagree (value is from the APS binary)

_community.note: bronze thresholds and missing bands merged from a MIT-licensed community dataset; binary-derived values win where they conflict
